Plugin.Name: Disk Identificator
Plugin.Overview: Light up the identification (locate) LED of a drive bay from the Unraid web UI, so you pull the right disk. Adds an ID button to every disk on the Dashboard and Main pages. Works with LSI/Avago/Broadcom HBAs: sas3ircu for SAS3 cards (SAS3008, SAS3216, SAS3224 and similar) and sas2ircu for SAS2 cards (SAS2008, SAS2308 and similar). Both utilities are bundled. Settings let you set the LED colour per enclosure, remap slots to LEDs when backplane cables are crossed, and add a location label for each bay.
